morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包保留独立词分析；这是英语词，th 表示清齿擦音 /θ/，不套用马来语词缀规则。

senses.zh_definition: 死亡；生命的终结，也指一次死亡事件或死亡状态。
senses.en_definition: The end of life, an instance of dying, or the state of being dead.
senses.ms_definition: Berakhirnya kehidupan, kejadian seseorang atau sesuatu mati, atau keadaan tidak lagi hidup.
senses.nuances: 英语释义。马来语通常用 kematian；这里的马来语定义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文。输入排名不能证明这是正式马来语词条。[Merriam-Webster: death](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/death)

senses.zh_definition: 比喻事物的消亡、终结，或导致毁灭的因素。
senses.en_definition: The disappearance or destruction of something, or something that brings about ruin.
senses.ms_definition: Berakhir atau lenyapnya sesuatu secara kiasan, atau perkara yang menyebabkan kemusnahan.
senses.nuances: 英语比喻义；马来语按语境用 berakhirnya、lenyapnya 或 kemusnahan，不宜逐字套用 kematian。[Merriam-Webster: death](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/death)

senses.zh_definition: 死神；将死亡拟人化的形象。
senses.en_definition: Death personified as a being that takes lives.
senses.ms_definition: Watak perlambangan yang menggambarkan kematian sebagai makhluk yang mengambil nyawa.
senses.nuances: 英语中通常写作 Death；文学形象随文化而异，不应直接等同于某一宗教中的天使。[Merriam-Webster: death](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/death)

collocations.zh: 将死神描绘成披袍身影
collocations.en: a depiction of Death as a robed figure

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 英文表格说明；目标词以英语引文出现
dual_scenarios.ms: Ruangan berlabel "cause of death" dalam borang bahasa Inggeris itu merujuk kepada punca kematian.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该英文表格中标为“cause of death”的栏目指的是死因。
dual_scenarios.en: The field labelled "cause of death" on the English form refers to the reason the person died.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论英文文件，含英语引文
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kat borang ni, "death" maksudnya kematian, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dalam borang ini, perkataan bahasa Inggeris "death" bermaksud kematian, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这张表里的“death”就是死亡的意思，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: On this form, "death" means someone has died, right?

messages.ms_spoken: Kat borang ni, "death" maksudnya kematian, kan?

messages.zh: 这张表里的“death”就是死亡的意思，对吧？
messages.en: On this form, "death" means someone has died, right?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya. Kalau "death certificate", maksudnya sijil kematian. Aku dah semak tadi.
messages.ms_standard: Ya. Frasa "death certificate" bermaksud sijil kematian. Saya sudah menyemaknya tadi.
messages.zh: 对。“death certificate”就是死亡证明，我刚才查过了。
messages.en: Yes. "Death certificate" means an official certificate recording a death. I checked earlier.

etymology.historical_story: English death continues Old English dēath through Middle English deeth. Its history belongs to the Germanic vocabulary of dying, with related forms recorded in Old Norse. The connection explains its place beside other inherited English words, but it supplies no evidence of Malay derivation or official Malay adoption. [Merriam-Webster: death](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/death)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 death 与 dead 配对记：dead 是“死的”，death 是“死亡”。词尾 /θ/ 要轻轻送气；这只是记忆联系，不是现代构词公式。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向家属表达慰问时宜用完整、体贴的马来语表达，如 Salam takziah，不宜只抛出 death 或 mati。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语通常使用 kematian；meninggal dunia 可用于较委婉地叙述某人去世。搭配栏提供马来语对应表达，不表示 death 已获正式马来语词汇认证。
